import numpy as np
def fit(cols,name):
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dP_dt-A@c
    print(name, np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt))
    return c
